children.title: Enable SLE Throughput Server (RX)
children.help:
Enable SLE throughput server (RX side).
Advertises, accepts connections, exposes SSAP service 0x2222/0x2323,
and counts received bytes for throughput reporting.

children.title: Enable SLE Throughput Client (TX)
children.help:
Enable SLE throughput client (TX side).
Connects to a peer MAC, discovers SSAP service 0x2222/0x2323,
and sends data at maximum rate for throughput testing.

children.title: Enable SLE Throughput App (WS63).
children.help:
SLE throughput test app (WS63), protocol-aligned with WS73 sle_tp_app.
Typical deployment: WS63 = RX (Server), WS73 = TX (Client).

children.title: Enable SLE Throughput Server (RX)
children.help:
WS63 RX side (default role). Advertises as "sle_tp_server",
exposes SSAP service 0x2222/0x2323, counts received bytes.
Pair with WS73 sle_tp_client (TX).

children.title: Enable SLE Throughput Client (TX)
children.help:
WS63 TX side (optional, for reverse test only).
Normal setup uses WS73 sle_tp_client as TX; leave this disabled.
